scope: Read-only generation review. No model weights downloaded, third-party code executed, environment changed, model trained, or CV scored.

decision.status: Recommend resource-gated evaluation of this one new pretrained generation; implementation not yet authorized by this report.
decision.reason: Untested synthetic HybridSCM pretraining and longer-context distribution; openly downloadable Apache-2.0 checkpoint; official non-CUDA core and explicit MPS device path. It is a model-generation change, not another seed/view ensemble.
decision.not_claimed: No Spaceship Titanic improvement is known. Reported author benchmark results require a different CUDA fine-tuning/bagging recipe. Static support is not proof of 16GB runtime feasibility.

tabpfn.observed_loader: Newer generations invoke ensure_license_accepted; V2 alone has direct download fallback. Existing experiments explicitly pinned old v2_default, not the current loader default.

tabicl.decision: Already tested generation. More estimators are budget changes and are outside this generation review.

alternatives.name: Google TabFM 1.0.0
alternatives.access: Public ungated metadata; this is not a claim that weight license equals code license.
alternatives.pretraining: Synthetic SCM tasks, per official documentation.
alternatives.decision: Not first choice on 16GB unified memory: 6.56GB weights alone, plus load copies/context activations; official MPS feasibility not established. No claim that all newer releases were exhaustively excluded.

mitra_v2.training_provenance: Authors describe purely synthetic mixed-prior pretraining, including Hybrid SCM. This is author provenance, not an independent dataset audit; no public competition predictions/answers were read.
mitra_v2.mechanism: Same 12-layer row/column-attention architecture as Mitra-v1; expanded context/features, optimizer and mixed within-graph synthetic mechanisms change pretraining.

claim_limit.reported_recipe: 50-step fine-tuning with 8-fold bagging, CUDA required by the official mitra-finetune recipe.
claim_limit.reported_budget: Official recipe documentation uses a nominal 3600-second task budget; its TabArena runner also describes per-child limits/salvage. These are framework budgets, not a promise of equivalent MPS runtime.
claim_limit.direct_zero_shot: Official AutoGluon example permits fine_tune=False; stock sklearn interface n_estimators=1. Default fine_tune is True, so False must be explicit.
claim_limit.comparison_limit: Single zero-shot or single adapted model is not a reproduction of the advertised 8-bag benchmark. A low score cannot reject the model family.

source.source_license: Apache-2.0; preserve upstream license/notices for any vendored adapter.
source.pin_note: Implementation must pin source commit and verify file hashes, not import mutable master. Web cached line numbers differed from current raw source.

dependencies.standalone_package_limit: mitra-finetune 0.3.0 lists small base dependencies, but its runtime API explicitly imports/requires AutoGluon with the Mitra extra. It is not a standalone replacement.
dependencies.lean_option: Vendor pinned official Tab2D, embedding, base, enums and official Preprocessor under retained Apache license; thin project inference adapter. Core files do not import AutoGluon. This is a project adapter, not a supported standalone upstream package.
dependencies.fine_tune_dependency_warning: Reusing official trainer also pulls internal callbacks/config/loss/scheduler/data modules and autogluon.common helper; dependency closure and equivalent behavior need separate source review before implementation.
dependencies.environment: Parent manages a separate environment or audited vendored dependency set; no installation performed.

runtime_findings.mps: Official sklearn interface chooses MPS after CUDA. Tab2D disables FlashAttention on non-CUDA and uses torch scaled_dot_product_attention.
runtime_findings.dtype: Official trainer config uses bfloat16 autocast; preprocessor outputs float32. Freeze float32/no-autocast for initial MPS probe if adapting current project convention; label the precision deviation. Do not assume bfloat16 works without testing.
runtime_findings.context: Official support cap8192 retains all4636 outertrain rows, but would randomly truncate final8693. Any full-context adapter must override cap>=8693 or omit sampling entirely.
runtime_findings.query: Default1024; proposed resource-only change is deterministic chunks128, each with the same full support. Query chunking does not remove support self-attention quadratic cost.
runtime_findings.memory: 303MB weights are not peak memory. Attention and 512-wide row/feature activations can dominate; exact full-context MPS viability unmeasured.
runtime_findings.save_reload: Core exposes save_pretrained/from_pretrained. Project artifact should save CPU state_dict/config, train-only preprocessor/category schema, CPU support X/y, and pinned hashes; reconstruct device at prediction. An end-to-end portable CPU artifact is not yet tested.

proposed_first_round.status: Planning only; parent must freeze final spec after resource-only probes and before any accuracy result.
proposed_first_round.inputs: Same 13 raw compact columns as TabPFN view experiment: HomePlanet,CryoSleep,Destination,Age,VIP,RoomService,FoodCourt,ShoppingMall,Spa,VRDeck,Deck,CabinNumber,Side. No PassengerId/Name, no spatial expert, no new feature search.
proposed_first_round.preprocessing: Per outertrain only: deterministic category vocabulary (unknown=0, missing=1, known>=2), float32 numerics preserving NaNs into official train-fitted Preprocessor mean imputation/constant filtering; no new log transforms or missing-indicator expansion. Use copies because upstream preprocessing mutates arrays. Core quantile bins derive from support only. Persist schema and test all-missing/unknown behavior. For adaptation inner preprocessing is fit only on innertrain and fresh on fulloutertrain at refit.

zero_shot.context: Entire outertrain; no subsampling. Final export entire8693 only after separate resource feasibility.
zero_shot.output: First two logits, stable softmax; class mapping persisted; threshold0.5 fixed.
zero_shot.adapter_difference: Fit official preprocessing directly on fulloutertrain; stock sklearn fit(False) still makes an inner20% split for prep/evaluation while predict uses full self.X/self.y. Avoiding this wasteful split is a declared adapter difference, not exact stock-wrapper reproduction.

proposed_first_round.adaptation_decision_before_cv: Before seeing any CV score, perform one full-size backward resource probe. If feasible, freeze a second single-model adaptation arm alongside zero-shot; if infeasible, assess only zero-shot and explicitly leave adaptation potential untested.

adaptation_if_feasible.parameter_origin: Official mitra-finetune binary/small-data recipe; optimizer and episodic query/support sampler must be copied/pinned with source review, not inferred from an unrelated stock default.
adaptation_if_feasible.selection: Fixed inner20% within each outertrain, select earliest minimum inner logloss step including step0, then fresh checkpoint/preprocessor and fulloutertrain episodic refit for selected steps. Outer validation labels never enter training/context/selection.
adaptation_if_feasible.limitation: This is a controlled single-model adaptation, not official 8-fold bagging. If best step is at cap and validation still improving, record non-saturation; do not declare the family exhausted.

resource_probe_before_scores: Anonymous pinned download/hash check only after parent authorization.
CPU synthetic small-input equivalence and unknown/missing handling; model+context save/reload probability match.
MPS4636 context x13 features with128query: warmup+second timed inference; record RSS/MPS peak or snapshots clearly labelled.
Estimate full2318query cost from actual repeated chunks; check query chunk invariance within numerical tolerance.
One backward episode at the frozen planned support/query sizes, no accuracy scoring; if too large mark adaptation unavailable, not bad.
Separate8693context128query check before claiming full-data export feasibility.
proposed_first_round.evaluation: Existing fixed dev3fold; report all folds, pooled accuracy/logloss and paired descriptive differences against existing TabPFN32/v44. No new holdout, no OOF weight/threshold search. Zero-shot has no early stopping. Only complete all-fold results count.
proposed_first_round.budget_policy: After probe timing, set sufficient stage budgets for3fold zero-shot and, if feasible,3fold inner+refit adaptation; serialize GPU work. Timeouts/OOM are inconclusive resource outcomes and never partial candidate wins.

independent_review.agreement: New synthetic prior is a genuine untested generation; small weights do not prove memory feasibility.
required_corrections: Avoid claiming CUDA8bag performance for single zero-shot.
Default8192 support cap would truncate final8693; handle explicitly.
Choose whether to include50-step single adaptation before looking at CV, using backward resource feasibility only.
